decision: Use one OverlayLifecycle per overlay. Flush computed opacity between removing hidden and adding active.
why: A single frame still paints opacity 1 in Chromium and Firefox.

decision: Photo and globe fade through that lifecycle. Teardown waits for the fade. Globe opens before the photo closes.
why: Same-turn class changes popped the scrim. Closing the photo first showed the gallery.
evidence: Frame probes in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. Open starts at opacity 0. Close stays on screen. One Back press clears the globe and leaves the URL.

decision: Modal uses inset 0 and a 100% content box.
evidence: Chromium modal width matches the layout width (1425 at a 1440 window). Content does not scroll sideways. Firefox and WebKit fill 1440.

decision: Next and previous pin the old box, then ease size, and fade a ghost 20px.
why: The photo jumped to the next aspect in one frame.
evidence: Three engines. First frame matches the old box. At least three frames sit between. One ghost during a five-step burst.

decision: A horizontal drag on the photo follows the finger.
why: The swipe waited until lift, so the photo felt stuck.
evidence: Chromium and WebKit at 390x844. An 80px drag translates 80px. A vertical drag and a second finger leave the transform at none. A short drag returns within 260ms.

decision: Shuffle keeps both rails reserved and morphs masonry after the flipboard.
why: The grid width popped when the timeline class changed the padding.
evidence: Padding is identical before, during, and after. Tile width stays put. On-screen tops glide.

decision: Instant tiles keep the hover scale and grayscale transitions.
why: After one shuffle every tile snapped its hover.
evidence: Computed transition is 0.32s transform. Hover scale is 1 then 1.035.

decision: One compact query covers narrow and short viewports. Desktop columns step down to a 150px tile.
why: 768 and 769 disagreed, and a short landscape still looked like a desktop.
evidence: Unit checks and Playwright at 769x900, 844x390, 667x375, and 900x900.

decision: The desktop photo and caption are one centered group. The phone globe is 30% of the facts row.
why: The caption sat far from the photo, and at 320px the copy column was about 75px.
evidence: Three engines. Gap is 32px. Side margins match. At 320x568 the copy column is 125px and the date is one line.

decision: Drop the exposure view transition. Delete the light-leak opacity transition.
why: The crossfade was still active past 380ms in Chromium and Firefox, and still active at 500ms in WebKit.
